verdict.rationale: The only sign of API versioning is the versioned endpoint reference 'createtokenv3'. There is also one backward-compatibility note saying existing username/password integrations stay supported and need not migrate, which hints at a non-breaking change approach. No formal versioning scheme or deprecation policy is documented. Missing for 10: an explicit API versioning scheme, a documented deprecation policy with timelines and sunset notices, a changelog or migration guides, and independent corroboration.
